name: Cuties Secreto Voice
overview: In her previous life, Ana Cruz returned after wandering for a long time; she humbled herself before her biological parents to win their favor and helped them secure an inheritance, only to meet a gruesome end at their hands—and her sister's. Upon being reborn, Ana decided to find herself a different father! She chose her inept eldest uncle, unaware that her grandfather had heard every single one of her thoughts...
